summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of GavixaCare healthcare platform. Backend APIs 100% functional. All Phase 1 features tested including auth, hospitals directory, AI bill fraud detector, AI cost estimator, emergency finder, and health vault. Both AI features (Claude Sonnet 4.5) working perfectly with real-time analysis.

ui_bugs.issue: Signup form submission does not redirect to /app dashboard after successful account creation. Form fills correctly but stays on /signup page.
ui_bugs.note: City field is optional and has no data-testid. Backend signup API works (verified via direct API test), so issue is likely in frontend redirect logic or error handling.

ui_bugs.issue: Email field is not disabled as specified in requirements. Should be read-only but is currently editable.
